item.title: Houston storms cause high water, stalling vehicles along I-45, Highway 288, and Buffalo Bayou
item.description: Storms that swept through Houston Saturday night into Sunday morning left roads slick and flooded in several areas, creating hazardous conditions for drivers.

item.title: Trump's 'roaring' economy meets a rough start to 2026: What the latest numbers show
item.description: President Donald Trump promised that 2026 would be a bumper year for economic growth, but instead it has kicked off with job losses, rising gasoline prices and more uncertainty about America's future.

item.title: 18-year-old charged with capital murder after deadly shooting in Houston Heights, HPD says
item.description: A day after a woman was shot and killed in the Heights, followed by an hours-long standoff with officers, an 18-year-old is charged with capital murder, according to Houston police.

item.title: Long TSA waits at Houston airports due to spring break travel, partial government shutdown
item.description: As spring break begins in the Houston area, officials at Hobby Airport and Bush Intercontinental Airport warn travelers of long TSA lines due to the partial government shutdown.

item.title: Decades after violence in Selma spurred the Voting Rights Act, organizers worry about its fate
item.description: The March 7, 1965, violence that became known as Bloody Sunday shocked the nation and helped spur passage of the landmark legislation that dismantled barriers to voting for Black Americans in the Jim Crow South.

item.title: 'Ghostbusters' actress Jennifer Runyon dies at 65
item.description: Jennifer Runyon, the actress known for her roles in "Ghostbusters" and "Charles in Charge," has died.

item.title: Rain moves out, leaving foggy conditions behind for Monday morning
item.description: The weekend showers and storms have fizzled out, though foggy and misty conditions will be left in their wake for Monday morning.

item.title: Man faces aggravated assault charges after pointing gun at Uber driver, records show
item.description: Court documents show that a man was charged with aggravated assault after pointing a gun at an Uber driver in Harris County.

item.title: 'It's 80% of our revenue': Business owner shares importance of Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo
item.description: A family-run restaurant owner shares the importance of The Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo to her business.

item.title: Crude oil prices surpass $100 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: Supply concerns have driven crude and gasoline higher as the war ensnares major oil-producing countries and hinders exports from the Persian Gulf.
